title: DevExp Standup - 2026-07-15
content:
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Liam O'Connor, Priya Singh, Diego Alvarez, Noah Patel

Date: 2026-07-15
Time: 10:00 - 10:25 PT
Location: Zoom / #devexp-standup

Summary: Quick weekly sync focused on SDK release prep (v0.9.x -> GA), docs work for streaming & function-calling, and consolidation of quickstarts/samples for onboarding. Mostly green but a couple of CI/infra blockers to clear before next week.

Yesterday / progress since last standup:
- SDK: beta v0.9.3 release candidate built and smoke-tested against hosted API. Python client packaging issue fixed (wheel metadata). Integration tests pass locally (Liam).
- Docs: updated streaming API guide draft and added code examples for Node/TS and Python (Priya). Added note about chunked JSON streams and recommended backpressure handling. PR submitted: docs#211.
- Quickstarts: consolidated Node and Python quickstarts into single repo layout (samples/quickstarts). Added a lightweight Next.js demo that uses streaming responses for chat UI (Diego).
- Samples: rl-agent-demo sample updated to include prioritized retry logic when rate-limited by Dedicated. Added README steps and env examples.
- CI: flaky test in sdk integration matrix traced to Node 20 runtime; pinned to node 18 in matrix while we validate Node 20 runtime in build infra (Noah).

Today / planned work:
- Maya: coordinate release plan for SDK GA (goal: 2026-07-22). Finalize release notes, cut release branch, and approve changelog.
- Liam: finish nightly regression run and file any failing test tickets. Verify packaging for arm64 wheel.
- Priya: address review comments on streaming guide, add troubleshooting section for common timeout patterns and example backpressure config.
- Diego: finish Next.js quickstart README, add screenshots and short video gif for README, open PR to samples repo.
- Noah: continue validation of Node 20 in CI infra, investigate regression that surfaced in linux-arm64 matrix.

Blockers / Risks:
- CI infra: Node 20 runtime causes intermittent failures in integration tests; hold on GA cut if we see regressions in nightly runs. Priority: high.
- Packaging: arm64 wheel variance in one test environment; might require rebuilding wheels in manylinux2022 container. Priority: medium.

Decisions made:
- GA date tentatively 2026-07-22 pending successful nightly regression and resolution of Node 20 flakiness.
- Pin CI matrix to Node 18 for release branch to ensure stability; continue parallel validation of Node 20 in a separate job.

Action items (owners):
- Maya: draft release notes and coordinate with marketing for SDK GA announcement (due 2026-07-19).
- Liam: open tickets for any failing integration tests and assign to infra if environment-related (due 2026-07-16).
- Priya: update streaming guide with troubleshooting and add examples for handling partial JSON chunks and reconnect logic (PR updates due 2026-07-16).
- Diego: finish quickstart PR with screenshots and gif, and add a one-click deploy workflow for Vercel (due 2026-07-17).
- Noah: run dedicated Node 20 validation job across all matrix targets and report findings (due 2026-07-16).

Notes / follow-ups:
- Suggestion from SRE: add a short section in docs about recommended client-side retry/backoff strategy when using Redwood Dedicated and rate-limiting responses. Priya to coordinate with SRE for wording and examples.
- Eval team requested a small eval harness for the Next.js quickstart to track latency/cost vs. model size when streaming; Diego to sync with Eval on requirements.
- Maya to prepare a short checklist for GA that includes: changelog approved, docs updated (streaming + function-calling), samples runnable, CI green on release branch, and compliance checklist complete.

Next standup: 2026-07-22 10:00 PT (GA day)

End.
